basic_info.description: Experience Elevated City Living at Gramercy Towers    Positioned just below the penthouse, this impeccably renovated one-bedroom residence offers breathtaking views of the Golden Gate Bridge and stunning sunsets to the west. The interior showcases a new open kitchen while the bathroom features thoughtful upgrades and enhancements. It also offers custom built-ins, recessed lighting, elegant wood floors, and expanded closet space.    Gramercy Towers provides an unparalleled lifestyle with 24-hour doorman service, concierge support, security guards, on-site management, and a health club featuring a gym, indoor pool, jacuzzi, and sauna. Your HOA dues cover premium amenities, including parking, water, garbage, electricity, heat, gas, basic internet, building insurance, and earthquake insurance.    Nestled just steps from world-class dining and shopping, this residence is your gateway to the best of city living.
